title: Český zákon o umělé inteligenci — national AI Act adaptation: supervision, sandbox, penalties
summary: MPO's lean adaptation act (~26 paragraphs) plugs AI Act enforcement into market-surveillance act 87/2023, designates national supervisors, creates a regulatory sandbox and sets fines; the plan's July 2026 effectiveness has already slipped (inter-ministerial comments spring 2026). CZ missed the EU authority-designation deadline while high-risk obligations phase in from Aug 2026.
notes: Stage: draft after MPR, heading to government (plan MPO-1: vlada 03.26, implementace 02.25 missed — infringement footnote). Distinct from seen reg-ai-act-milestones (EU dates): this is the CZ enforcement vehicle. Enforcement-gap window: deployers face EU duties with no national supervisor. Sandbox = testing ground for AI startups. Draft, date slipped — expect late 2026.

title: SAE Level 3 autonomous driving legal on Czech motorways from 2026
summary: A road-traffic amendment effective 1 Jan 2026 defines automated vehicles for the first time and permits SAE Level 3 operation on selected motorway sections; while the system drives, the person is legally not the driver and responsibility shifts to the manufacturer/system. In force — market-opening.
notes: Stage: in force. Market created: homologated L3 features (traffic-jam pilots), insurance products for shifted liability, data-recorder/telemetry compliance. Note: primary is a dated legal-journal analysis (epravo 1/2026), corroborated by industry association (AutoSAP) coverage of the presidential signature; MD implementing rules follow.

title: Battery Regulation — supply-chain due diligence duties apply (postponed to Aug 2027)
summary: Regulation (EU) 2025/1561 ('stop the clock', OJ 30 Jul 2025) postponed the Battery Regulation's due-diligence chapter: from 18 Aug 2027, companies over EUR 40m turnover placing batteries on the EU market must run third-party-verified supply-chain due diligence on cobalt, lithium, nickel, natural graphite (Commission guidelines due 26 Jul 2026). Distinct from the Feb 2027 battery-passport obligation already on the radar.
notes:
- Verified via Council press release 18 Jul 2025 and OJ publication: new application date 18 Aug 2027; guidelines by 26 Jul 2026; scope trimmed in parallel omnibus (SME relief) — final scope worth re-checking at transposition.
- CZ exposure: battery/module plants, Škoda EV chain, industrial-battery importers above the threshold; policies, risk-management plans and notified-body verification needed.
- Market created: raw-material traceability platforms, due-diligence audits, alignment work with CSDDD/forced-labour regimes.

title: CCD2 transposition — BNPL, zero-interest and microloans enter consumer-credit regulation
summary: MF amendment to Consumer Credit Act 257/2016 (inter-ministerial comments Feb 2025) transposes directive CCD2 with effect on the binding EU date 20 Nov 2026: scope extends to BNPL, interest-free credit and small short-term loans, with stricter creditworthiness assessment and advertising rules.
notes: Stage: draft — bill predates the 10/2025 election and must be (re)passed by 11/2026; the transposition deadline binds regardless (draft, date at risk). Largest ZSU change since 2016 (epravo: 'zasadni regulatorni prelom'). BNPL providers face licensing/ CNB supervision; embedded-finance products re-papered.

title: CCD2 — new consumer credit rules apply, BNPL and sub-EUR 200 loans in scope
summary: Directive (EU) 2023/2225 (CCD2) applies from 20 Nov 2026: consumer-credit rules extend to BNPL, interest-free deferred payments and loans under EUR 200, with mandatory creditworthiness assessment, ad rules and cost caps left to member states. Every CZ BNPL provider, e-shop instalment scheme and nebankovní poskytovatel needs relicensing-grade compliance rework.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 48: transposition by 20 Nov 2025, measures apply from 20 Nov 2026. CZ novela zákona o spotřebitelském úvěru in progress.
- Who: BNPL (Twisto, Skip Pay), e-commerce checkout finance, non-bank lenders, banks' consumer arms; ČNB supervision widens.
- Market created: creditworthiness-assessment APIs, affordability data services, compliant credit-ad tooling, loan-documentation rebuilds.

title: Nový cizinecký zákon — rewrite of foreigner entry and residence law
summary: MV prepares a new act on entry and residence of foreigners (accompanying changes act to government Dec 2026), planned effect Jan 2029 — a full rewrite of the permit regime employers of foreign workers depend on. A separate security package (effect Jan 2027) tightens returns and entry restrictions first.
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan MV-9); security package MV-6 per usneseni vlady 16.12.2025 c. 1017 (vlada 06.26, ucinnost 01.27). Labor-shortage tension: employers need faster channels while the political frame tightens. Market: immigration-compliance services, HR tech.

title: DORA register of information — annual submission to ČNB via SDAT, 2026 cycle deadline 2 March
summary: Czech financial entities (banks, insurers, payment/e-money institutions, investment firms, fund managers, intermediaries) must maintain a register of information on all ICT third-party contracts and submit it to ČNB through SDAT; the current collection deadline was 2026-03-02, with ČNB notifying each entity of its specific obligation in writing. Collection recurs as part of the ESAs' oversight cycle feeding designation of critical ICT providers.
notes: Distinct from DORA applicability itself (already tracked): this is the concrete CZ reporting mechanics; solo entities report individually, groups at top consolidation level; market: RoI tooling, contract-metadata extraction, DORA compliance SaaS.

title: Vyhláška ČNB 1/2026 Sb. — updated application and notification requirements in the payments sector
summary: ČNB decree amending vyhláška 355/2020 Sb. on applications and notifications for licensing and related filings under the payments framework, effective 2026-01-11. Payment institutions, e-money issuers and applicants must use the updated forms and annexes.
notes: Published 2026-01-08 per ČNB supervisory news; enforcement ČNB; niche but standing licensing-compliance mandate for the payments sector.

title: Car CO2 targets — 2025-2027 three-year averaging window closes, 2030 minus-55% ahead
summary: Regulation (EU) 2025/1214 lets carmakers meet the 2025 CO2 fleet target (93.6 g/km WLTP) as an average over 2025-2027 instead of annually — deficits in 2025-26 must be clawed back by end-2027 or fines follow, and the unchanged 2030 step (-55% cars / -50% vans vs 2021) comes next. Skoda/VW group EV mix planning and the CZ supplier chain hang on this compliance math.
notes:
- Verified: Reg (EU) 2025/1214 (17 Jun 2025) amends Reg 2019/631 for a 2025-2027 pooled compliance period; 2030/2035 targets untouched (2035 zero-emission review pulled to 2025-26 under auto action plan — watch).
- CZ exposure: Škoda Auto BEV ramp (Elroq/Epiq), tier-1/2 suppliers' volumes tied to EV mix, pooling-market payments (Tesla/Mercedes pools).
- Market created: compliance forecasting/pooling brokerage, residual-value and pricing analytics for EV push years, charging demand planning.

title: Company-law digitalization (dir 2025/25) — EU company certificate and once-only filings
summary: MSp transposition of Directive (EU) 2025/25 digitalizes company-law procedures — EU company certificate, cross-border once-only principle, registry interconnection; to government Oct 2026, effect Jul 2027 (transposition deadline 07.27).
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan MSp-7, RVIS ano). Goal: 'dosahnout vyssi miry digitalizace, transparentnosti a pravni jistoty v oblasti prava obchodnich spolecnosti'. Market: registry data services, KYB providers get standardized cross-border company data.

title: New Construction Products Regulation — applies, digital product passport regime for building materials
summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/3110 (new CPR) applies since 8 Jan 2026, replacing the 2011 CPR family by family: new harmonised technical specifications arrive as delegated acts, adding environmental sustainability declarations, digital product passports for construction products and permanent-link digital documentation. CZ manufacturers, importers and distributors of building materials face a decade of rolling re-declaration work as each product family switches over.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 96: in force 7 Jan 2025, applies from 8 Jan 2026 (institutional articles earlier); old CPR 305/2011 repealed gradually as new harmonised specs land (acquis work plan to 2030, transition to 2039).
- Who: CZ výrobci stavebních hmot (cement, insulation, windows, prefab), importers, builders' merchants; DoP/DoC rework plus CE-marking updates per family.
- Market created: DoP/DPP generation SaaS for construction, LCA/EPD calculation services, product-data management for builders' merchants — pairs with EPBD/ZEB demand for whole-life-carbon data.

title: CRD6 — third-country banks must branch to serve EU clients from 2027
summary: CRD6 (Directive (EU) 2024/1619) applies from 11 Jan 2026, and from 11 Jan 2027 its third-country regime bites: non-EU banks providing core banking services (deposits, lending, guarantees) into member states generally need an authorised branch there, ending cross-border servicing from London/Zurich/New York except reverse solicitation. CZ corporates' non-EU banking relationships and fintech partnerships get restructured.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 2: transpose by 10 Jan 2026, apply from 11 Jan 2026; Art 1 points (9),(13) — incl. Art 21c branch requirement — apply from 11 Jan 2027 (48k/48l registration earlier).
- CZ exposure: UK/US/Swiss banks serving CZ corporates and wealthy clients; CZ subsidiaries of non-EU groups re-routing treasury lines through EU entities; ČNB licensing of TC branches.
- Market created: booking-model restructuring advisory, reverse-solicitation policy frameworks, branch-authorisation projects.

title: Digital technical map (DTM) — standing duty of infrastructure owners and builders to feed krajské IS DTM
summary: Since 2024-07-01 every owner, administrator and operator of transport and technical infrastructure must register and maintain its network data in the regional digital technical maps via the unified JVF DTM exchange format (vyhláška 393/2020 Sb. as amended by 186/2023 and 140/2024, one provision from 2025-01-01), and builders must submit as-built geodetic documentation on completion. Live and enforced nationwide through ČÚZK's DMVS portal.
notes: Enforcement ČÚZK + kraje; JVF DTM 1.5.0 published as future version — format migrations keep recurring; market: geodetic surveying boom, JVF conversion tooling, utility GIS integration.

title: Zákon 270/2025 Sb. + implementing decrees — psilocybin as an individually prepared therapeutic product
summary: From 2026-01-01 psilocybin can be prescribed as an individually prepared medicinal product: blue-stripe prescriptions by specialized physicians only, capped at 75 mg per patient per month, with conditions set by a government regulation and novely of vyhlášky 85/2008 Sb. and 329/2019 Sb. plus updated controlled-substance lists (NV 463/2013, NV 11/2025). Czechia becomes one of the first EU states with a regulated psilocybin-therapy pathway.
notes: Supervision SÚKL + MZd; market created: psychedelic-assisted therapy clinics, compounding pharmacies, specialist training.

title: Dálniční známka — end of automatic CPI indexation and drive-type discounts
summary: Amendment to Road Act 13/1997 abolishes the annual inflation indexation of the e-vignette and removes price advantages tied to vehicle drive type (CNG/plug-in-hybrid discounts, EV exemption regime); to government Apr 2026, planned effect Nov 2026.
notes: Stage: draft (plan MD-3, RIA ano: 'Zrusit kazdorocni navysovani sazeb casoveho poplatku... a odstranit stavajici zvyhodneni vozidel navazane na typ jejich pohonu'). PSP tisk 246 (novela 13/1997 - EU) was in 2nd reading 8/2026 — verify whether same vehicle. Fleet TCO shifts for alt-fuel vehicles; price predictability for carriers. Draft, date at risk.

title: Distance financial services — withdrawal button and modernised rules in force
summary: Directive (EU) 2023/2673 applies since 19 Jun 2026 (old 2002/65/EC repealed): financial services sold online must offer a prominent 'withdrawal function' — a button to cancel within the 14-day right, pre-contractual disclosures adapted to apps, rules against dark patterns and a right to human intervention alongside chatbots. Every CZ online lender, insurer and investment app must redesign onboarding and cancellation flows.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 2: transpose by 19 Dec 2025, apply from 19 Jun 2026; repeal of Dir 2002/65/EC effective 19 Jun 2026.
- Who: online sjednání půjček/pojištění/investic — banks' digital channels, insurtech (Pillow, Mutumutu), investment platforms (Portu, Fondee), comparison sites closing sales online.
- Market created: withdrawal-flow UX/compliance patterns, disclosure tooling, dark-pattern audits of financial funnels.

title: DPH novela 2027 — ViDA OSS adjustments plus gastro-rate and bad-debt refund changes
summary: MF VAT amendment effective 1 Jan 2027 implements ViDA art. 2 (One-Stop-Shop special scheme changes, EU deadline 12/2026); the linked EET package adds a lower VAT rate on non-alcoholic drinks in catering and shortens bad-debt VAT refunds from 6 to 3 months. Submitted to government Mar 2026.
notes: Stage: vlada 03.26 per Plan legislativnich praci 2026 (item MF-1), ucinnost 01.27. Distinct from seen reg-vida-timeline (EU calendar): this is the CZ transposition vehicle. Programme also pledges 0% VAT on prescription drugs and raising the VAT-payer threshold 'vyrazne nad 2 miliony' (needs EU derogation, undated). Draft, date at risk.

title: Důchodová novela — richer valorization, 80+ age bonuses, retirement age capped at 65
summary: MPSV pension amendment (PSP tisk 270, in 1st reading) raises the real-wage weight in indexation, adds age-based increases from age 80 every 5 years and better terms for working pensioners, effective 1 Jan 2027. The government programme further pledges capping the retirement age at 65 — reversing the 2024 reform trajectory toward 67.
notes: Stage: PSP 1. cteni (tisk 270); vlada 04.26; RIA ano. Plan goal: 'zmirnit zaostavani vyvoje zivotni urovne duchodcu... zvysenim zapoctu rustu realne mzdy... a posileni prijmove urovne duchodcu ve vyssim veku'. Fiscal counter-signal: reversal of parametric reform re-opens long-term sustainability gap (payroll/pension modeling demand).

title: EET 2.0 (zákon o evidenci tržeb) — cash-revenue registration returns for all sectors from 2027
summary: New sales-registration act obliges businesses across all sectors to report revenues to Finanční správa from 1 Jan 2027; minor side-income exempt, no mandatory receipt printing or permanent online connection, free state software. Passed Chamber 3rd reading 15 Jul 2026, now in Senate.
notes: Stage: PSP passed 15.7.2026 -> Senate; MPŘ from 19.2.2026, vláda 6/2026. Goal (leg. plan 2026): 'omezeni sede ekonomiky, zefektivneni vyberu dani a zajisteni feroveho prostredi pro podnikatele napric vsemi sektory'. Programme: 'nebude vyzadovat povinny tisk uctenky ani neustale on-line pripojeni... zdarma software Financni spravy'. Sweeteners bundled: tip-income tax exemption, skolkovne + student credit return, lower VAT on non-alco drinks in gastro. Market: POS/accounting integrations for every cash-accepting business; replaces EET 1.0 (2016-2020, scrapped 2023).

title: Zákon o ekonomické ochraně státu + new FAÚ act — Czech AML-package institutional rebuild
summary: Three-bill package (economic protection of the state, Financial Analytical Office act, related changes act) adapts AMLD6/AMLR/AMLAR; to government Oct 2026, effect Jul 2027 aligned with AMLR application 10 Jul 2027. Rebuilds the national AML/sanctions supervision architecture.
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan MF-10/11/12, RIA ano, anti-corruption council review ano). Distinct from seen reg-amlr-single-rulebook (EU rulebook dates): this tracks the CZ institutional vehicle — FAU statute, economic-security/sanctions enforcement powers. Obliged entities get a new supervisor interface; compliance vendors: watch VeKLEP Oct 2026.

title: Energetický zákon novela — hydrogen/renewable-gas market rules (dir 2024/1788) + REMIT II
summary: Amendment to Energy Act 458/2000 transposes the EU hydrogen and decarbonised gas market directive and REMIT-II wholesale-market-manipulation rules; to government Apr 2026, planned effect Sep 2026. Implementation overdue since May 2024 — plan footnote flags infringement with 'realnou moznosti navrzeni financni sankce' under art. 260(3) TFEU.
notes: Stage: draft (vlada 04.26 per plan, item MPO-8), date at risk. Creates licensing and network rules for hydrogen/renewable gases and strengthens REMIT surveillance duties for traders. Market: hydrogen infrastructure projects get a legal frame; energy traders face new compliance.

title: EPBD — zero-emission requirement for new public buildings 2028, all new buildings 2030
summary: Distinct EPBD recast milestones beyond transposition: from 1 Jan 2028 all new buildings owned by public bodies must be zero-emission (no on-site fossil combustion, top-tier energy demand), and whole-life-cycle GWP must be calculated and disclosed in the energy certificate for new buildings over 1,000 m2; from 1 Jan 2030 both duties extend to every new building. CZ public procurement of schools, offices and housing flips to ZEB specs first.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 7(1)-(2): ZEB for public-body new buildings 1 Jan 2028, all new buildings 1 Jan 2030; life-cycle GWP disclosure >1,000 m2 from 2028, all from 2030. Deep-renovation definition switches to ZEB standard in 2030 (Art 2).
- Complements existing reg-epbd-recast record (transposition/infringement); this is the dated obligation wave that hits design and procurement now — buildings permitted in 2026-27 deliver into the 2028/2030 regime.
- Market created: whole-life carbon (LCA) calculation for permits, ZEB-spec design services, fossil-free heating engineering, public-procurement ZEB templates.

title: ERÚ amended price decision for 2026 — POZE renewables charge zeroed for all customers, state budget pays
money_note: POZE component was 495 CZK/MWh for households before zeroing
summary: ERÚ's změnový cenový výměr issued 2025-12-29 (after the government decision of 2025-12-16) sets the POZE renewables-support component of regulated electricity prices to zero from 2026-01-01, shifting financing fully to the state budget. Regulated price falls ~15.1% for households, 21.0% at high voltage and 34.2% at very high voltage year-on-year.
notes: Annual price-decision regime (recurring); suppliers must reflect new tariff composition in billing; watch fiscal sustainability — reversal risk in later years.

title: Vyhláška 132/2026 Sb. — electricity-sharing overhaul: 100-EAN groups, territorial limits scrapped, EDC settlement changes
summary: ERÚ amendment to the electricity market rules (vyhláška 408/2015 Sb.) removes the 3-ORP territorial restriction on energy communities, extends the efficient five-round sharing allocation to groups of up to 100 consumption/production EANs, and adds EDC rules for evaluating technical flexibility and storage. Configurable in EDC from 2026-08-01, applied in practice from 2026-09-01, with further waves 2027-01-01 and 2027-07-01.
notes: Enforcement ERÚ/OTE-EDC; unlocks larger community-energy projects; market: sharing-group operators, settlement SaaS, flexibility aggregators; CZ still lacks dynamic/hybrid sharing methods (SK has them).

title: ESG Rating Providers Regulation — ESMA authorisation regime applies
summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/3005 applies since 2 Jul 2026: ESG rating providers operating in the EU need ESMA authorisation (existing providers had to notify by 2 Aug 2026 and file within four months or cease), with governance, methodology-transparency and conflict-of-interest rules; small providers get a lighter registration route. Users of ESG ratings — banks, asset managers — gain disclosure they will demand from vendors.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Arts 50/53: applies 2 Jul 2026; transitional notification by 2 Aug 2026, application within 4 months; small-provider temporary regime.
- CZ exposure: few home-grown raters, but CZ fintechs scoring ESG data, consultancies issuing 'ratings' and any bank white-labelling scores must check scope; buyers (ČS, KB asset management) re-paper vendor contracts.
- Market created: authorisation dossier support, methodology documentation, EU-entity structuring for non-EU raters.

title: ESPR — ban on destroying unsold clothing and footwear, DPP infrastructure starts
summary: Under ESPR (Reg (EU) 2024/1781), destroying unsold apparel and footwear (Annex VII) is prohibited for all but micro/small companies since 19 Jul 2026 (medium-sized from 19 Jul 2030), with annual disclosure of discarded volumes for other operators; the Commission's digital product passport registry also went live by the same date. E-commerce and fashion retail must build resale/donation/recycling channels and reporting.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 25 + Art 13: ban from 19 Jul 2026 (medium enterprises 19 Jul 2030); DPP registry by 19 Jul 2026; first ESPR working plan (Apr 2025) queues textiles, furniture, tyres, mattresses, steel/aluminium for delegated acts — product DPP obligations land ~2027-2029.
- CZ exposure: fashion e-commerce (Zalando-style returns economics), Alza/Notino-scale retailers with apparel lines, 3PL returns handlers.
- Market created: returns refurbishment and resale-as-a-service, unsold-inventory redistribution platforms, destruction-disclosure reporting tooling, DPP readiness for textiles.

title: ETS2 delayed to 2028 — Czech government threatens non-implementation
summary: The European Parliament approved (10 Feb 2026) postponing ETS2 allowance surrender for building and transport fuels by one year to 1 Jan 2028; the Czech government programme explicitly declares readiness 'neimplementovat tento system do ceske legislativy'. Fuel suppliers face a regime whose national transposition is politically frozen.
notes: Stage: EU passed-awaiting-effect; CZ transposition absent from the 2026 legislative plan (deliberate). Programme quote: 'V pripade emisnich povolenek pro domacnosti a dopravu ETS2 jsme pripraveni neimplementovat tento system... a zabranit vysoce negativnim socialnim dopadum'. Estimated household impact 200-400 CZK/month at EUR45/t. Suppliers' MRV duties already run; non-implementation would trigger infringement — compliance prep needed either way. Sources: MZP ETS2 page + programove prohlaseni PDF.

title: ETS2 — carbon price on heating and road fuels starts 2028 (postponed from 2027)
summary: ETS2 puts a cap-and-trade carbon price on fuels supplied to buildings, road transport and small industry; co-legislators postponed the start from 2027 to 2028 (agreed March 2026 in the 2040-climate-target deal). Fuel suppliers, not consumers, must hold permits, run verified MRV (already mandatory since 2025) and surrender allowances annually, passing costs into CZ heating and motor fuel prices.
notes:
- Dates verified on Commission climate page: permits required since 1 Jan 2025; monitoring/reporting since 2025 (verified from 2026); system 'fully operational in 2028' after one-year postponement; surrender by 31 May each year thereafter; soft price trigger at EUR 45 (2020 prices) releases MSR allowances in first two years.
- CZ exposure: fuel distributors, teplárny (heating plants outside ETS1), ORLEN Unipetrol/ČEPRO supply chains; pass-through raises heating bills — Social Climate Fund plans channel compensation.
- Market created: ETS2 MRV software and verification, allowance procurement/hedging for mid-size fuel suppliers, carbon-cost pass-through analytics, Social Climate Plan consulting.

title: European Disability Card — mutual recognition of disability status applies
summary: Directive (EU) 2024/2841 (transpose by 5 Jun 2027, apply from 5 Jun 2028) creates the European Disability Card and Parking Card: preferential conditions offered to persons with disabilities — transport fares, culture, sport, leisure, parking — must be honoured for card-holders from other member states. CZ operators of paid public-facing services must recognise foreign cards and retool eligibility checks.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 21: adopt by 5 Jun 2027, apply from 5 Jun 2028 (parking-card IT allowances to 2029 in places).
- CZ exposure: dopravní podniky fare systems, kina/divadla/muzea discount schemes, sport venues, parking operators; links to CZ průkaz ZTP digitalisation.
- Market created: eligibility-verification integration, ticketing-system updates, accessibility-adjacent govtech.

title: Elektronizace zdravotnictví — binding MZd interoperability standards from 1 Jan 2026
summary: Amendment 236/2025 to eHealth Act 325/2021 took effect 1 Jan 2026: healthcare providers must comply with electronic-health standards issued by the ministry, enabling central digitization projects and structured data sharing. In force and enforced.
notes: Stage: in force. January 2026 package also amended public health insurance, drug and health-services laws (MZd bilancni TZ: 'V lednu 2026 vstoupi v ucinnost novely rady zakonu a vyhlasek'). Market: HIS/EHR vendors certify against standards; laggard providers exposed. EHDS CZ adaptation follows separately (plan MZd-2, vlada 06.26, ucinnost 03.27 — EU side covered by existing reg-ehds record).

title: FASTER — fast withholding-tax relief system, digital residence certificates (transpose by end-2028)
summary: Directive (EU) 2025/50 (FASTER) must be transposed by 31 Dec 2028 and applies from 1 Jan 2030: member states with significant listed markets provide relief-at-source or quick-refund for dividend withholding tax, built on EU-wide digital tax residence certificates and registered financial-intermediary reporting. CZ custodian banks and brokers join a certified intermediary regime; cross-border investors finally escape multi-year refund queues.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 25: transpose by 31 Dec 2028, apply from 1 Jan 2030; eTRC issued within 14 days; national intermediary registers.
- CZ exposure: custodians (ČSOB, Česká spořitelna, Komerční banka), brokers (Patria, Fio) as registered intermediaries; CZ retail investors holding EU dividend stocks.
- Market created: eTRC integration, intermediary due-diligence/reporting platforms, withholding-tax reclaim automation (Taxback-style, but API-first).

title: Gigabit Infrastructure Act — new and renovated buildings must be fibre-ready
summary: Under Regulation (EU) 2024/1309 (GIA), buildings with permit applications after 12 Feb 2026 — new construction and major renovations — must include fibre-ready in-building physical infrastructure and fibre wiring to each end-user point, with access points for multi-dwelling buildings; a voluntary 'fibre-ready' label follows. CZ developers and renovators add a mandatory telecom layer to every project.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 10: permit applications after 12 Feb 2026 trigger the duty; exemptions for single-dwelling/military/listed buildings; member states may certify 'fibre-ready' labels.
- Also in GIA since Nov 2025: faster permits for network rollout, duct access, coordination of civil works — relevant to CZ operators (CETIN, T-Mobile fibre).
- Market created: in-building fibre design/installation as standard subcontract, fibre-ready certification services, developer compliance checklists in stavební řízení.

title: IED 2.0 — industrial permits tighten: strictest achievable BAT ranges, EMS, transformation plans
summary: Directive (EU) 2024/1785 (IED 2.0) had to be transposed by 1 Jul 2026: permit limits must sit at the strictest achievable end of BAT ranges, operators need environmental management systems, energy-efficiency binding values and (by 2030 for large installations) decarbonisation transformation plans; scope extends to large battery gigafactories and, from 2030, big pig/poultry farms. Every CZ IPPC-permitted plant faces permit reopenings on the new logic.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 4: transposition deadline 1 Jul 2026; obligations phase in with post-Jul-2026 BAT conclusions (4-year windows per installation); CZ novela zákona o integrované prevenci running through legislature.
- Who: ~1,400 CZ IPPC installations — chemicals (Spolchemie, Orlen Unipetrol), metallurgy (Třinecké železárny, Liberty), cement, waste, intensive agriculture.
- Market created: permit-application consulting, EMS/ISO 14001+50001 implementation, transformation-plan drafting, continuous-monitoring tech.

title: IRRD — recovery and resolution regime arrives for Czech insurers
summary: Two MF bills (a new act on recovery and resolution in insurance plus an Insurance Act amendment) transpose IRRD with planned effect Jan 2027 (EU deadline 29 Jan 2027): insurers must maintain preventive recovery plans and ČNB gains resolution powers. To government Apr 2026.
notes: Stage: draft (plan MF-2/MF-3, RIA ano). Compliance market: recovery-planning, resolution valuation, actuarial stress-testing for a sector that never had a resolution regime. Draft, date at risk.

title: Katastr novela — anti-scraping limits on cadastre data, faster deed registration
summary: MZe/ČÚZK amendment to the Cadastre Act aims to 'zamezit nelegalnimu vytezovani a zneuzivani udaju katastru', tighten personal-data protection while keeping the register public, and streamline vkladové řízení; to government Jun 2026, effect Jul 2027.
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan MZe-3, RVIS ano). PropTech risk: bulk cadastre mining faces restrictions; opportunity: compliant API access, title-monitoring services. Also optimizes obnova operatu and narrows cadastre offences to 'nejvyznamnejsi jednani'.

title: Zákaz klecových chovů nosnic od 2027 — 4.5 million hens must move
summary: Amendment 501/2020 to the animal-protection act bans cage housing of laying hens from 1 Jan 2027; when passed, 67.6% of Czech layers (~4.5M hens) were caged. Producers must convert to barn/free-range or exit — now under 5 months out, with no compensation scheme resolved.
notes: Stage: passed-awaiting-effect (signed 19.11.2020; deadline 1.1.2027). Senate-flagged dispute over 'nahradu vynalozenych nakladu' never resolved. Market: conversion capex, barn equipment, egg-price/import dynamics (cage eggs from abroad remain legal to sell — enforcement asymmetry).

title: Zákon o kritických surovinách — CRMA adaptation with permitting fast-track for strategic projects
summary: New act adapts EU Critical Raw Materials Regulation 2024/1252 (authorities, permitting deadlines for strategic extraction/processing projects — Cínovec lithium context); to government Apr 2026, planned effect Sep 2026. CZ overdue since May 2024 — infringement risk noted in the plan.
notes: Stage: draft (vlada 04.26 per plan, item MPO-9), date at risk. CRMA requires single points of contact and permit deadlines (27/15 months) for strategic projects. Market: mining/processing revival, permitting consultancy, battery supply chain localization.

title: Regulace lobbování 168/2025 — registration-only lobbying since 2026
summary: Lobbying Act 168/2025 took effect 1 Jul 2025; since 2026 lobbying may only be performed after registration in the RELOB register, with disclosure duties and sanctions. By Mar 2026 the register held 621 lobbyists, 731 intermediaries and 2,310 lobbied officials.
notes: Stage: in force + enforced (transition ended; unregistered systematic lobbying now sanctionable). RRF-milestone-driven law. PA agencies, associations and in-house lobbyists file periodic reports; Transparency International's first-half review debates 'transparentnost, nebo zbytecna byrokracie'. Market: registration/reporting compliance for PA sector.

title: MDR/IVDR transition cliff — legacy device certificates expire 2027-2029 by class
summary: Regulation (EU) 2023/607 ends the MDR grace period: legacy-certificate class III and implantable IIb devices may only be placed on the market until 31 Dec 2027, remaining IIb/IIa/class I sterile-or-measuring until 31 Dec 2028; Reg (EU) 2024/1860 sets IVDR cut-offs at 31 Dec 2027 (class D), 2028 (C) and 2029 (B + A sterile). Manufacturers without completed MDR/IVDR conformity assessment lose EU market access class by class.
notes:
- Dates verified in both regulations' Art 120/110 amendments (Cellar full text): MDR 31 Dec 2027 class III + IIb implantable (excl. WET list), 31 Dec 2028 other IIb, IIa, class I sterile/measuring and up-classified devices; IVDR D 2027, C 2028, B/A-sterile 2029.
- CZ exposure: Linet, BTL, ELLA-CS and ~hundreds of SME device makers plus distributors of legacy-certified imports; notified-body capacity is the bottleneck.
- Market created: regulatory-affairs consulting, technical-documentation remediation, clinical evaluation services, portfolio-rationalisation advisory.

title: Financování ČT/ČRo ze státního rozpočtu — abolition of licence fees for households and firms
summary: Government bill (PSP tisk 231, submitted 19 Jun 2026 by the culture minister) moves public-media financing to the state budget, ending TV/radio fees paid by households and — since the 5/2025 increase, per-employee-scaled — by firms; planned effect 1 Jan 2027.
notes: Stage: PSP 1st reading pending (organizacni vybor 24.6.2026, garant: vybor pro medialni zalezitosti). Plan goal: 'Snizit zatez obcanu a firem novym zpusobem financovani verejne sluzby... primo ze statniho rozpoctu... pri respektu k zavazku zachovani jejich nezavislosti'. Reverses 2025 fee indexation; firms drop a per-employee fee compliance line. Watch: media-independence dispute may slow passage.

title: EU Methane Regulation — importers must prove equivalent MRV from 2027, intensity limits from 2030
summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/1787: from 1 Jan 2027 importers of oil, gas and coal must demonstrate that new supply contracts carry producer-level methane MRV equivalent to EU rules and report annually; from 5 Aug 2028 producers/importers report methane intensity, and contracts concluded after 5 Aug 2030 must meet maximum intensity thresholds. CZ gas and coal import chains inherit a documentation burden reaching back to wellhead data.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Arts 27-29: importer information duties since 2025; equivalence demonstration for contracts from 1 Jan 2027; intensity reporting 5 Aug 2028; intensity limits for new contracts 5 Aug 2030; coal-mine venting bans from 1 Jan 2027 (5t/kt threshold).
- CZ exposure: ČEZ/innogy gas portfolios, coal importers, industrial buyers with direct supply contracts renegotiating terms.
- Market created: supplier MRV attestation and OGMP 2.0 data services, contract-clause remediation, methane accounting platforms.

title: VAT 2026 wave of novela 461/2024 Sb. — redefined financial-services exemption and digital tourist refunds
summary: Deferred provisions of the big VAT amendment took effect 2026-01-01: the §54 financial-activities exemption is redefined so debt-collection agency services, investment-instrument record-keeping and TV/radio fee collection become taxable, and VAT refunds for third-country tourists are digitalized. Affected financial firms had to re-price and re-classify services from January.
notes: Enforcement GFŘ/Finanční správa; live and enforced; follows the 2025 waves (registration limits, real-estate rules) of the same novela.

title: VAT 2027 wave — end of the 420k CZK car-deduction cap plus proposed gastro-drinks and bad-debt changes
summary: Enacted novela 461/2024 Sb. abolishes the 420,000 CZK cap on VAT deduction for passenger cars from 2027-01-01 (end of 'Lex Ferrari'). A parallel government bill for the same date would move all non-alcoholic beverages in restaurants to the 12% rate and ease bad-debt VAT relief (threshold 20,000 CZK, waiting period cut from six to three months).
notes: Car-cap abolition is law; the rest is a pending bill bundled with EET 2.0 — flag when tracking; enforcement Finanční správa.

title: EET 2.0 — government bill to reinstate electronic sales records for cash, card and QR payments
money_note: government projects +14-15bn CZK/yr in tax revenue
summary: The government's bill reintroduces electronic sales registration from 2027-01-01 covering in-person payments by cash, card, QR and future technologies; an 'EET OFF' regime exempts businesses under 1M CZK annual revenue for a 1,400 CZK monthly flat fee, and mandatory receipt printing is dropped. Bill is still in the legislative process — date is the proposed effectiveness.
notes: NOT YET ENACTED — proposed date; enforcement Finanční správa; market: POS/cash-register software refresh wave across all cash-accepting businesses, repeat of the 2016 EET vendor boom.

title: Vyhláška 131/2024 Sb. o dokumentaci staveb — old-format project documentation accepted only until 30 June 2027
summary: Under the new building act's documentation decree, builders may submit project documentation drawn under the previous regulations only with permit applications filed by 2027-06-30; afterwards all documentation must follow the 131/2024 structure. Designers and engineering firms must migrate templates and workflows before the cutoff.
notes: Confirmed by MMR methodological guidance; enforcement stavební úřady; pairs with vyhláška 146/2024 Sb. on construction requirements; portál stavebníka/ISSŘ run in maintenance mode until 2030 with planned 2028 integration into the new territorial-development authority.

title: Pension reform (417/2024 Sb.) — guaranteed minimum pension at 20% of average wage from 2026
summary: From 2026-01-01 the state guarantees a minimum old-age pension of 20% of the national average wage, nearly double the 2025 floor, as part of the 417/2024 Sb. reform. The same reform keeps age 65 for cohorts through 1971 and adds 2 months per birth year from 1972, linking retirement age to life expectancy from the 1985 cohort.
notes: Administered by ČSSZ; early-retirement window narrows from 5 to 3 years with higher penalties; parameters phase in through 2027 (slower indexation of new pensions).

title: Hazardous-profession early retirement — employer surcharges and one-off 2015-2024 shift certificates due end-2026
summary: Workers in category-4 risk jobs (extended set from 2025) earn old-age retirement 1 month earlier per 184 shifts worked, without pension reduction; employers pay a rising pension-insurance surcharge for them (+3% in 2026, reaching +5% from 2028) and must keep shift evidence. Employers must issue one-off certificates of 2015-2024 shift counts by 2026-12-31 so past work counts.
notes: Enforcement ČSSZ + hygiene stations (kategorizace prací); market: payroll/HR software updates, occupational-health categorization consulting.

title: Zákon 236/2025 Sb. — eHealth novela: eŽádanka, mandatory ePoukaz, emergency record, unified data standard
summary: Amendment to the healthcare-electronization act 325/2021 Sb. effective 2026-01-01 (some provisions 2026-04-01): introduces eŽádanka replacing paper referrals with trackable waiting times, a mandatory ePoukaz for medical devices, an emergency health record (blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, last-year medication) and a unified data standard for cross-provider and cross-border document exchange; eRecept newly exposes dispensed-medication data via the emergency record. Coincides with full effectiveness of 325/2021 — from 2026-01-01 all providers must comply with MZd electronic-health standards.
notes: Enforcement MZd/ÚZIS; forces upgrade of every ambulatory/hospital information system; market: EHR vendors, integration middleware, patient-app layer on EZKarta.

title: Vyhláška 237/2025 Sb. — NZIS reporting expanded for the new national preventive & screening registry
summary: Amendment to vyhláška 373/2016 Sb. on data transfers to the National Health Information System obliges providers to report defined data in connection with the new Národní registr preventivních a screeningových vyšetření, applying from January 2026 per the MZd legislative overview. Creates a standing structured-reporting duty for preventive-care and screening events.
notes: Enforcement ÚZIS/MZd; feeds prevention-oriented reimbursement; market: registry-export modules in clinical software.

title: Zákon 289/2025 Sb. — health-insurance novela: cross-border provider contracts, cashless insurers, benefit funds
summary: Amendment to act 48/1997 Sb. effective 2026-01-01 lets Czech insurers contract foreign providers for covered care, makes white dental fillings and modern children's dentistry fully reimbursed, ends cash payments at insurer counters, introduces instalment schedules and a public-benefit fund while abolishing the reserve fund. Companion act 288/2025 Sb. carves medical-device and dental-product reimbursement into a standalone categorization act.
notes: Enforcement MZd + health insurers; expands prevention bonus programs; market: cross-border care coordination, dental.

title: Zákon 290/2025 Sb. — health-services novela: mandatory hospital ombudsman, one-day care, asbestos duties
summary: Amendment to act 372/2011 Sb. effective 2026-01-01 introduces the hospital patient-ombudsman institute, expands one-day surgical care, sets a framework for chaplaincy care, and removes a set of bureaucratic provider duties. Companion changes tighten employer obligations for work with asbestos (risk-prevention measures, work notifications, training certificates).
notes: Supporting decrees: 380/2025 (pohotovostní služby), 399/2025 and 444/2025 (staffing/equipment of children's complex-care centres, hospices), 449/2025 (occupational-health services in crisis states), 402/2025 + NV 473/2025 (lead/diisocyanate/asbestos exposure limits).

title: Vyhláška 380/2025 Sb. o pohotovostních službách — minimum staffing, equipment and hours for urgent care
summary: New decree sets minimum material-technical equipment, staffing and time coverage for each type of out-of-hours service — adult and pediatric medical pohotovost, dental emergency and pharmacy emergency service — applying from January 2026 per the MZd legislative overview. Hospitals, dental providers and pharmacies running pohotovost must meet the parameters.
notes: Enforcement kraje + MZd; interacts with reimbursement decree; affects regional urgent-care network planning.

title: Vyhláška 432/2025 Sb. — reimbursement decree for 2026 setting payments and regulatory limits for all providers
money_note: governs distribution of the ~CZK 500bn public health-insurance system; system planned in deficit for 2026
summary: The annual úhradová vyhláška fixes 2026 reimbursement levels and regulatory limits between health insurers and every segment of care providers, effective 2026-01-01. Accompanied by vyhláška 424/2025 Sb. (annual update of the seznam výkonů point values) and 421/2025 Sb. (DRG-development contributions).
notes: Recurring yearly mandate; determines revenue of every hospital/praxe; market: revenue-optimization analytics for providers.

title: Vyhláška 557/2025 Sb. — waste-management details novela: new evidence rules and first annex-13 annual reports
summary: Amendment to vyhláška 273/2021 Sb. effective 2026-01-01: waste producers, facility operators and traders file their 2025 annual waste reports in 2026 for the first time under the new annex 13 structure (continuous evidence already ran per new rules through 2025), and the transition period for the hazardous-waste landfilling ban is extended to end-2027. Follows the 18/2025 Sb. novela effective 2025-02-01.
notes: Enforcement MŽP/ČIŽP via ISPOP; recurring annual reporting mandate; market: waste-evidence software updates (INISOFT et al.).

title: Deposit return scheme for PET bottles and cans — bill resubmitted with launch pushed to 2028
money_note: deposit proposed at 4-5 CZK per container
summary: After the original packaging-act amendment fell with the 2025 election cycle, a practically identical bill was resubmitted to the Chamber at the end of 2025 proposing mandatory deposits on PET bottles and cans from 2028-01-01, obligating shops over 50 m² and all fuel stations (11,000+ locations) to take containers back. If it fails again, EU law forces a mandatory DRS from 2029 unless Czechia hits an 80% collection rate in 2026.
notes: NOT YET ENACTED — public consultation closed 2026-01-07; enforcement MŽP; market: reverse-vending machines, clearing operator, collection logistics, label/EAN registration.

title: Municipal textile collection — every obec must run separate textile-waste collection since 2025
summary: Under §59(2) of the waste act 541/2020 Sb. with details in vyhláška 273/2021 Sb., every municipality must provide separate collection of textile waste from 2025-01-01, clearly distinguishing waste textil from re-use collection. Live and enforced; municipalities choose containers, sběrné dvory or bag collection.
notes: Enforcement ČIŽP + kraje; precedes the EU textile EPR regime; market: textile collection/sorting operators, municipal contracts.

title: Nature Restoration adaptation — Národní plán obnovy přírody anchored in Czech law
summary: MŽP amendment to Nature Protection Act 114/1992 sets competences and procedure for the National Nature Restoration Plan (EU Reg 2024/1991 requires national plans by 1 Sep 2026) plus stronger urban-tree protection and functional felling levies; to government Sep 2026, effect Sep 2027.
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan MZP-7, RIA ano). NRP submission deadline 1.9.2026 looms before the act exists. Land-use impact for developers and agriculture; market: ecological restoration services, monitoring. Draft, date at risk.

title: Vyhláška 334/2025 Sb. o Portálu NÚKIB — mandatory channel and formats for registrations and incident reports
summary: Decree establishing Portál NÚKIB as the communication channel between regulated organizations and the cyber authority, prescribing format and content requirements for registering regulated services, reporting incidents and other filings, effective 2025-11-01. All entities under act 264/2025 Sb. must transact through it.
notes: Procedural backbone of the new regime; incident-reporting deadlines per regime run through this portal; market: incident-response retainers, reporting automation.

title: Vyhláška 408/2025 Sb. o regulovaných službách — defines who falls under the new Czech cyber act
summary: Implementing decree to act 264/2025 Sb. (NIS2 transposition) listing service categories and size criteria that place an organization in the lower or higher cybersecurity obligations regime, effective 2025-11-01. Affected organizations had to self-identify and register their regulated service with NÚKIB within 60 days (by 2025-12-30).
notes: Concretizes NIS2 scope for ~thousands of orgs across 22 sectors; enforcement NÚKIB; market: scoping/gap-analysis consulting, GRC tooling, virtual CISO services.

title: Vyhláška 409/2025 Sb. — security measures for the higher obligations regime
summary: Decree under act 264/2025 Sb. detailing organizational and technical security measures (risk management, asset management, incident handling, supply-chain security) that higher-regime providers of regulated services must implement, effective 2025-11-01. Replaces the old vyhláška 82/2018 regime for critical/essential entities.
notes: Enforcement NÚKIB (audits, fines up to 2% turnover under the act); ČNB+NÚKIB joint statement 2026-06-24 delineates overlap with DORA for financial entities; market: ISMS implementation, SOC/MSSP services, audit.

title: Vyhláška 410/2025 Sb. — security measures for the lower obligations regime
summary: Decree under act 264/2025 Sb. setting the lighter minimum security-measure set for lower-regime regulated services (most mid-size companies newly caught by NIS2), effective 2025-11-01. First-time cybersecurity compliance duty for the long tail of Czech medium enterprises.
notes: Largest newly-regulated population; enforcement NÚKIB; market: packaged compliance-in-a-box offerings, MSP security upsell for SMEs.

title: Vyhláška 411/2025 Sb. — security levels of public-administration information systems
summary: Decree under act 264/2025 Sb. classifying public-administration information systems into security levels and assigning corresponding protection requirements, effective 2025-11-01. State and municipal bodies must map their ISs to levels and align controls.
notes: Enforcement NÚKIB; drives procurement of security uplifts across public IT; market: public-sector security integrators.

title: Vyhláška 412/2025 Sb. — security rules for public bodies using cloud computing
summary: Decree under act 264/2025 Sb. setting security rules public authorities must follow when using cloud computing services, effective 2025-11-01, superseding the previous cloud-decree regime. Constrains which cloud offerings are eligible for government workloads.
notes: Gatekeeps the government cloud market; cloud vendors selling to Czech public sector must meet the rules; enforcement NÚKIB.

title: Zákon o podpoře v bydlení — part three live: housing assistance and support instruments
summary: The Housing Support Act (signed 3 Jun 2025) phases in: 115 mandatory contact points for housing at ORP municipalities from 1 Jan 2026 (132 total with voluntary ones), and part three — asistence v bydlení plus supportive instruments including guarantees — effective 1 Jul 2026. In force.
notes: Stage: in force (staged effectiveness). Creates a standing municipal infrastructure and a contracting market: social-housing operators, guarantee administration, case-management software, training for KMB staff. Continuation risk under the new government low — obligations already binding.

title: Public country-by-country tax reporting — first reports being published
summary: Directive (EU) 2021/2101 requires multinationals with revenue over EUR 750m to publish country-by-country income-tax reports for financial years starting on or after 22 Jun 2024 — for calendar-year groups the FY2025 report must be on the company website/register within 12 months of year-end, i.e. by 31 Dec 2026. CZ subsidiaries and branches of foreign groups carry local publication duties even when the parent is outside the EU.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 48g: rules apply from first FY starting on/after 22 Jun 2024; publication within 12 months of balance-sheet date; CZ transposition via zákon č. 349/2023 Sb. amending accounting rules.
- Who: CZ dceřiné společnosti of EUR 750m+ groups (automotive, retail chains, tech), large CZ groups (EPH, PPF, Agrofert) with EU revenue.
- Market created: CbCR data preparation and XHTML/format filings, tax-narrative communications advisory, monitoring of competitors' disclosed tax footprints.

title: Revised RVP curricula — mandatory rollout postponed to 9/2027 (MŠ) and 9/2028 (ZŠ)
summary: Minister Plaga announced (26 Feb 2026) a one-year delay of the largest curriculum reform in 20 years: revised preschool RVP mandatory from Sep 2027 and new basic-school RVP in grades 1+6 from Sep 2028 (originally 2026/2027), citing insufficient school support. Voluntary adoption continues since Sep 2025.
notes: Stage: passed-awaiting-effect (curriculum framework approved; rollout schedule ministerial). Plaga: 'situace je horsi, nez se zdalo... posouvam start o rok'. Every MS/ZS rewrites its SVP; edtech, textbook and teacher-training market window extended by a year. Prior schedule per edu.gov.cz was 9/2027 for ZS.

title: Slovakia — mandatory B2B e-invoicing and real-time reporting from 2027
summary: Slovakia's VAT-act amendment (approved by parliament 9 Dec 2025) mandates structured e-invoicing with near-real-time reporting for domestic B2B transactions from 1 Jan 2027 on a Peppol five-corner model, voluntary from May 2026, cross-border from 1 Jul 2030 in line with ViDA. Every CZ company trading with Slovak counterparties — the largest CZ trade partner group — needs compliant issuance/receipt via its ERP.
notes:
- Dates: law passed National Council 9 Dec 2025; domestic B2B mandate 1 Jan 2027; voluntary phase May 2026; cross-border 1 Jul 2030 (Commission eInvoicing country page + KPMG/Comarch advisories; final published wording worth confirming in Zbierka zákonov).
- Follows the DE/FR/BE/PL wave already on file — completes the encirclement of CZ, making a CZ domestic mandate under ViDA a matter of time.
- Market created: Peppol access-point services for CZ-SK invoicing, ERP localisation (Pohoda, Money S3, Helios), e-reporting middleware.

title: Školský zákon — PHAmax financing makes teaching assistants standard positions
summary: MŠMT amendment institutionalizes teaching assistants in mainstream primary schools and družiny under PHAmax funding caps — individually recommended assistants for specific pupils end — and anchors state-funded psychologists/special pedagogues in kindergartens and secondary schools; to government Aug 2026, effect Sep 2027.
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan MSMT-1, RIA ano). Goal quote: 'Vytvorit jednotny a transparentni system financovani asistentu pedagoga... jiz nebude v bezne zakladni skole mozne asistenta pedagoga doporucit jako individualni podpurne opatreni'. Inclusion-funding shift contested by parent groups; school staffing markets affected.

title: SoHO Regulation — new regime for blood, tissues, cells applies
summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/1938 on substances of human origin applies from 7 Aug 2027, replacing the blood and tissues directives: SoHO entities need registration or authorisation, preparation authorisations with clinical-outcome evidence, vigilance reporting into the EU SoHO Platform, and supply-continuity alerts. CZ transfusion services, tissue establishments, IVF clinics and plasma centres must re-paper their entire quality systems.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 89: applies 7 Aug 2027 (a few platform/committee articles 2024, some national-plan articles 7 Aug 2028).
- CZ exposure: fakultní nemocnice transfusion departments, ÚHKT, plasma industry (CSL Plasma, Takeda chain), reproductive clinics (large CZ cross-border IVF sector — donor traceability tightens).
- Market created: SoHO quality-management systems, vigilance/reporting integration, authorisation dossier consulting, donor-management software upgrades.

title: Solvency II review + IRRD — insurers' new prudential and resolution regime applies
summary: Directive (EU) 2025/2 (Solvency II review) and Directive (EU) 2025/1 (IRRD) must be transposed by 29 Jan 2027 and apply from 30 Jan 2027: proportionality for small insurers, tightened long-term guarantee rules, sustainability-risk plans, plus first-ever EU insurance recovery-and-resolution planning with pre-emptive plans covering most of each national market. CZ insurers and ČNB face a full prudential-regime rebuild during 2026.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex: Dir 2025/2 Art 4 and Dir 2025/1 Art 100 — transpose by 29 Jan 2027, apply from 30 Jan 2027.
- Who: Kooperativa/ČPP (VIG), Generali ČP, Allianz CZ and small mutuals (proportionality classification); ČNB gets resolution-authority duties.
- Market created: actuarial model updates, ORSA/climate scenario tooling, recovery-and-resolution plan drafting, regulatory reporting upgrades.

title: Zákon o podpoře startupů — first Czech startup-framework act
summary: MPO+MPSV are to submit a startup support act to government by Dec 2026 (planned effect Jan 2028), fulfilling a government-programme commitment; RIA commissioned. Expected to define 'startup' and anchor support instruments (ESOP treatment among debated items).
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan item MPO-17: 'V navaznosti na zavazek uvedeny v Programovem prohlaseni vlady pripravit zakon o podpore startupu', RIA ano). Watch VeKLEP autumn 2026. Market: legal definition unlocks targeted programs; ecosystem lobbying window open now. Draft, date at risk.

title: Short-term rental registration — EU STR regulation (2024/1028) lands in Czech law
summary: Amendment to Tourism Act 159/1999 implements EU Reg 2024/1028: hosts obtain registration numbers and platforms (Airbnb, Booking) must share activity data with authorities; the EU application date 20 May 2026 is already missed, with the CZ bill to government Jun 2026 and effect 1 Jan 2027.
notes: Stage: draft (plan MMR-1, RIA ano; implementace 05.26 overdue). Creates the enforcement data layer Prague and Brno have demanded for years. Market: host-compliance tooling, municipal analytics; platforms build CZ reporting pipelines. Draft, date at risk.

title: Short-term rental Regulation — host registration numbers and monthly platform data sharing
summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/1028 applies since 20 May 2026: where member states run registration schemes, Airbnb/Booking-type platforms must display host registration numbers, run random checks and share monthly activity data (nights, guests) with authorities via national single digital entry points. It is the data backbone for CZ's eTurista regime and municipal STR limits in Prague.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex Art 19: applies from 20 May 2026 (in force since Jun 2024).
- CZ angle: eTurista + novela živnostenského zákona wiring STR registration; Prague pushes for regulation powers; platforms must integrate with the CZ entry point.
- Market created: registration/compliance flows for hosts and property managers, municipal STR monitoring dashboards, data integration between platforms and public administration.

title: Vyhláška 422/2025 Sb. — pharmacy practice novela legalizing self-service dispensing boxes for mail-order medicines
summary: Amendment to vyhláška 84/2008 Sb. on correct pharmacy practice sets procedures for mail-order dispensing of medicines via self-service pickup boxes and adds rules for preparing gene-therapy medicinal products, applying from January 2026 per the MZd legislative overview. Opens a compliant channel for pharmacy box/locker networks.
notes: Supervision SÚKL; market created: medicine pickup-box infrastructure and e-pharmacy logistics; complements eRecept/ePoukaz digitization.

title: Superdávka — legacy-benefit switch-over completed July/August 2026
summary: The unified state social assistance benefit (in force 1 Oct 2025) merges four benefits (housing allowance, child allowance, living allowance, housing supplement); existing recipients transition on 1 Jul 2026 — delayed from 1 Apr — with first unified payouts in Aug 2026, applications digital-first via ÚP/Jenda.
notes: Stage: in force, transition milestone hit now. The 3-month slip of the conversion itself signals IT/administrative strain (state-failure watch). Hundreds of thousands of households re-assessed; work-bonus component changes incentives. Programme adds a planned regional housing component up to 6,000 CZK/month.

title: Toy Safety Regulation — digital product passport for every toy, chemicals tightened
summary: Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 (in force 23 Dec 2025) replaces the Toy Safety Directive from 1 Aug 2030: every toy placed on the EU market needs a digital product passport accessible by QR code, stricter chemical rules (PFAS, endocrine disruptors banned) and online marketplaces must display DPP/warnings at point of sale. Toys become the first mass consumer category with a universal DPP — the compliance template for CZ toy importers and e-shops.
notes:
- Verified on EUR-Lex final provisions: applies from 1 Aug 2030 (54-month transition); committee/delegation articles 28-44, 49-55 already apply since 1 Jan 2026; DPP specs via implementing acts expected 2027-2028.
- CZ exposure: toy importers/distributors, e-shops (Alza, Bambule chains), CZ manufacturers (Detoa) and marketplace sellers; customs will check DPP presence.
- Market created: DPP issuance SaaS for toys, chemical compliance testing, marketplace listing-compliance tooling — early movers here template ESPR categories.

title: Elektronizace vnitřní správy — omnibus digitalizing registry-office agendas
summary: MV omnibus ('dalsi elektronizace postupu na useku vnitrni spravy') creates the legal frame for full digitalization of selected internal-administration agendas (civil registries and related acts); to government Jun 2026, effect Jan 2027, with RIA and RVIS review.
notes: Stage: draft (plan MV-5: 'Reagovat na identifikovane nedostatky v oblasti elektronizace vybranych agend a institutu na useku vnitrni spravy a vytvorit pravni ramec umoznujici jejich plnohodnotnou digitalizaci'). Procurement/govtech pipeline follows effectiveness. Draft, date at risk.

title: Nový zákon o bankách — full rewrite replacing act 21/1992
summary: MF will replace the 1992 Banking Act — per the plan 'zastaralou, nekonzistentni a nesystematickou pravni upravu' — with a new act also transposing the amended Deposit Guarantee Schemes Directive; to government Dec 2026, planned effect Apr 2028.
notes: Stage: pre-draft (plan MF-14, RIA ano). Every bank and branch re-papers licensing, governance and DGS mechanics to a new statute; definitional work will shape fintech-bank boundaries. RIA problem statement = the quoted obsolescence claim. Draft, date at risk.

title: Zálohový systém PET lahví a plechovek — restarted bill, launch pushed to early 2028
summary: The deposit-return bill fell with the 2025 election and was resubmitted near-identically (PSP tisk 193, 10th term); the key change is postponing system launch to the beginning of 2028, with a ~4 CZK deposit set by decree. PPWR forces a mandatory DRS by 1 Jan 2029 unless CZ reaches 80% collection in 2026 — 2022 reality: 73–75% of PET, 26% of cans.
notes: Stage: PSP (tisk 193 distributed 5/2026; predecessor tisk 818/9th term died with the chamber). Obligations: producers join the operator, stores above threshold must take containers back. Market: reverse-vending machines, logistics, operator IT. Draft, date at risk (EY tax alert 8.1.2026 documents the 2028 slip).

title: ZKB 264/2025 decree calendar — security-measure deadlines roll through 2027; supply-chain NVs pending
summary: Cybersecurity Act 264/2025 (in force 1 Nov 2025) with decrees 408–412/2025 requires services registered since late 2025 to implement full security measures within 1 year of their NÚKIB registration decision — deadlines land rolling from early 2027. Two government regulations enabling the supply-chain screening mechanism (strategically significant services, critical functions) are still in the legislative pipeline.
notes: Distinct from seen reg-nis2-cz-zkb (the act itself): this tracks implementation — 60-day registration wave closed 12/2025-1/2026, decisions issuing, measures deadlines 2027, mechanism NVs in VeKLEP.
